text: Hi, I'm Bill Carter. I was just wondering how much it costs to replace a whole bathroom's plumbing?

We don't have a flat rate for a whole bathroom plumbing replacement, but our diagnostic visit is $89 to have a technician inspect it and provide an estimate. Would you like to schedule a diagnostic visit?
Can't you just give me a rough estimate? Like, a ballpark figure?

Because every bathroom layout and scope of work is different, our technicians need to inspect it in person to give you an accurate price. Our diagnostic visit fee is $89, which goes toward the job if you move forward.
Well, around here usually what do people pay for something like that? Surely you must have an average.
I don't have average figures available because every job varies so much. I can get a technician out to evaluate your bathroom and give you an exact quote for $89.
I'll have to think about it. Thanks anyway, bye.
Thank you for calling Lakeside Plumbing and Heating. Have a great day!
